ei.title: HRM in the Volatile Tourism Industry
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The tourism and hospitality industry is particularly sensitive to economic cycles and political trouble and can be badly affected in times of uncertainty. For example, the global nature of the industry means that it is vulnerable to external events that cause fluctuations in tourist visits and spend. The global 2001-2004 economic downturn, 9/11, the Iraq War and the outbreak of SARS all led to a drop in revenue in the industry. These factors reduced the number of travellers internationally and left uncertainty and fragility in the tourism market. Many of these aspects are particularly pronounced in the airline industry and trade unions have often railed against the manner in which employees are used as 'shock absorbers' to protect the industry from the cyclical nature of the market. These hard approaches to HRM have seen major redundancy programmes in a number of airlines in recent years, especially after 9/11. On the other hand, a number of companies have sought a more soft approach to HRM which aimed at increasing the customer responsiveness of their front-line staff. British Airways, for example, had a series of initiatives in the 1980s and 1990s such as 'Putting People First' and 'Winning for Customers'. Among other things, these initiatives sought to introduce teamwork, implement extensive training programmes, enhance quality procedures, and develop multi-skilled staff. As companies alternate between hard and soft approaches to HRM, employees may become confused as to what the company message is. Ultimately, employees may well be a company's 'greatest asset', but in times of uncertainty and downturn are equally expendable as recent history suggests.

The global 2001-2004 economic downturn, 9/11, the Iraq War and the outbreak of SARS all led to a drop in revenue in the industry. These factors reduced the number of travellers internationally and left uncertainty and (C)[fragility / stability] in the tourism market. Many of these aspects are particularly pronounced in the airline industry and trade unions have often railed against the manner in which employees are used as 'shock absorbers' to protect the industry from the cyclical nature of the market. These hard approaches to HRM have seen major redundancy programmes in a number of airlines in recent years, especially after 9/11. On the other hand, a number of companies have sought a more soft approach to HRM which aimed at increasing the customer responsiveness of their front-line staff. British Airways, for example, had a series of initiatives in the 1980s and 1990s such as 'Putting People First' and 'Winning for Customers'. Among other things, these initiatives sought to introduce teamwork, implement extensive training programmes, enhance quality procedures, and develop multi-skilled staff. As companies alternate between hard and soft approaches to HRM, employees may become confused as to what the company message is. Ultimately, employees may well be a company's 'greatest asset', but in times of uncertainty and downturn are equally expendable as recent history suggests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① resistant(저항력 있는): 경기 순환에 '민감한' 산업이라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ② immune(면역인): '외부 사건에 취약한'이라는 원문과 모순
✅ ③ sensitive - vulnerable - fragility = 원문과 일치
❌ ④ stability(안정성): 불확실성과 '취약함'을 남겼다는 원문과 반대
det.tip: sensitive(민감한), vulnerable(취약한), fragility(취약함)은 모두 관광 산업의 불안정성을 강조하는 단어이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① redundancy - extensive - expendable = 원문과 일치
❌ ② recruitment(채용): 9/11 이후 대규모 '해고' 프로그램이라는 원문에 채용은 반대
❌ ③ minimal(최소한의): '광범위한' 교육 프로그램이라는 원문과 모순

Ultimately, employees may well be a company's 'greatest asset', but in times of uncertainty and downturn are equally expendable as recent history suggests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 pronounced와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ noticeable(눈에 띄는): pronounced는 '확연한, 두드러진'이라는 의미로 noticeable과 가장 가깝다
❌ ① subtle(미묘한): 반의어에 가까움
❌ ② moderate(적당한): 두드러진 정도와는 다름
❌ ③ concealed(감춰진): 확연히 드러나는 것과 반대
det.tip: particularly pronounced = particularly noticeable. '특히 두드러진'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 enhance와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① improve(개선하다): enhance와 의미가 가장 가깝다
❌ ② diminish(줄이다): 향상의 반대
❌ ③ maintain(유지하다): 현 상태 유지이며 향상과 다름

det.tip: enhance quality procedures = improve quality procedures. 둘 다 '품질 절차를 향상시키다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.passage:
(A) The global nature of the industry means that it is vulnerable to external events that cause fluctuations in tourist visits and spend.
(B) Spending time in nature has been shown to reduce stress levels and improve overall mental health.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 nature의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)에서 the global nature of the industry는 산업의 '전 세계적 특성'이므로 '자연'이 아님
✅ ② (A) nature = 본질/특성 (산업의 글로벌한 '성격') / (B) nature = 자연 (자연에서 시간을 보내면 스트레스 감소)
❌ ③ (A)에서 '산업의 글로벌한 자연'은 어색함
❌ ④ (B)에서 'Spending time in 본질'은 의미가 통하지 않음
det.tip: the nature of ~(~의 본질/특성)은 추상적 개념이고, in nature(자연에서)는 구체적 장소를 가리킨다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a period of reduced economic activity; a decline in the economy"

det.analysis:
✅ ③ downturn(경기 침체): 경제 활동이 감소하는 시기, 경제 하락이라는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ① revenue(수익): 소득이나 수입을 뜻하며 경제 활동 감소와 다름
❌ ② fluctuation(변동): 오르내림을 뜻하며 '감소/하락'이라는 방향성과 다름
❌ ④ initiative(계획): 새로운 시도를 뜻하며 경제 하락과 무관
det.tip: downturn = a decline in economic activity. 본문에서 '2001-2004 economic downturn'으로 사용되었다.

questions.passage: These factors reduced the number of travellers internationally and left __________ (certain) and fragility in the tourism market.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 자리에 형용사를 명사형으로 바꿔야 한다.
det.analysis: left 뒤에 목적어 자리이고 and fragility와 병렬 구조로 나열되는 명사 자리이므로, 형용사 certain에 접두사 un-과 접미사 -ty를 붙여 명사 uncertainty로 바꿔야 한다. uncertainty and fragility 두 명사가 and로 연결된 병렬 구조이다.
det.tip: certain → uncertainty. 'left + 목적어' 구조에서 fragility(명사)와 and로 연결되므로 명사 형태가 필요하다.

questions.passage: Many of these aspects are particularly __________ (pronounce) in the airline industry and trade unions have often railed against the manner in which employees are used as 'shock absorbers' to protect the industry from the cyclical nature of the market.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 보어 자리에 동사를 형용사(과거분사)로 바꿔야 한다.
det.analysis: 'are particularly ___' 구조에서 주격 보어 자리이며, 'aspects가 두드러진' 수동/상태의 의미이므로 동사 pronounce를 과거분사 pronounced로 바꿔야 한다. pronounced는 형용사로 '확연한, 두드러진'이라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: pronounce → pronounced. 'are particularly pronounced'에서 pronounced는 '확연한'이라는 형용사적 과거분사이다.
